Package com.workshop.mcp.spec.builders

Class CreateSamplingMessageBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.workshop.mcp.spec.builders.CreateSamplingMessageBuilder
public class CreateSamplingMessageBuilder extends Object
Builder class for creating CreateSamplingMessage instances following the Builder pattern. This builder ensures that at least one Message is present in the messages list, while all other fields can be null.
